Instructions: Participants memorised sequences of red square locations in a 4 x 4 grid. Each square was preceded by a symmetry judgement task in which participants judged whether a black-and-white pattern was vertically symmetrical. At the end of each set, participants recalled the square locations in the order presented.
Notes: Practice trials were excluded. Rows correspond to recorded events from the test block only. Original Inquisit cumulative scoring fields were not retained because some were not reliably populated. Performance measures were reconstructed from event-level data using task structure and stimulus-response mappings.

block.Description: Task block label from Inquisit. Only TestBoth rows are retained.

Levels.solve_symmetry: Participant judged whether the stimulus was symmetrical.
Levels.show_square: A red square location was presented for memory encoding.

trial_number.Description: Trial/event number from the Inquisit output.

response.Description: Participant response recorded for the event.

set_size.Description: Number of square locations to be remembered in the current set.

square_location.Description: Presented square location in the 4 x 4 grid for show_square events.

symmetry_problem_count.Description: Running count of symmetry problems presented.

symmetry_timeout.Description: Timeout threshold for symmetry judgement trials.

presented_sequence.Description: Reconstructed sequence of presented square locations for each memory set, separated by vertical bars. Populated on square_feedback rows.

recalled_sequence.Description: Reconstructed sequence of participant-recalled square locations for each memory set, separated by vertical bars. Populated on square_feedback rows.

correct_squares.Description: Number of square locations recalled correctly in the correct serial position for the reconstructed memory set. Populated on square_feedback rows.

set_correct.Description: Whether the reconstructed memory set was recalled perfectly.

sspan_running.Description: Running reconstructed Symmetry Span score, calculated as the cumulative sum of set sizes for perfectly recalled sets.

total_correct_squares_running.Description: Running reconstructed total number of square locations recalled correctly in the correct serial position.

total_recalled_sets_running.Description: Running reconstructed count of perfectly recalled memory sets.

symmetry_true_answer.Description: Reconstructed correct answer for the symmetry stimulus based on task-defined stimulus mapping.

symmetry_correct.Description: Recalculated correctness of the participant symmetry judgement based on stimulus identity and response.

symmetry_accuracy_running.Description: Running recalculated proportion of correct symmetry judgements.

final_sspan.Description: Final reconstructed Symmetry Span score repeated across rows for this participant.

final_total_correct_squares.Description: Final reconstructed total number of correctly recalled square locations repeated across rows for this participant.

final_total_recalled_sets.Description: Final reconstructed number of perfectly recalled sets repeated across rows for this participant.

final_symmetry_accuracy.Description: Final recalculated proportion of correct symmetry judgements repeated across rows for this participant.
